blocks.zh: Ongoing Process Control | 持續製程控制
blocks.en: Ongoing Process Control

blocks.zh: 解讀與實務指引
blocks.en: Interpretation and Practical Guidance

blocks.zh: 持續製程控制的四大支柱
blocks.en: The Four Pillars of Ongoing Process Control

blocks.zh: 完成PQ（績效確效）後，滅菌製程並未結束——而是進入「持續維護」階段。PDA TR1將此階段歸納為四大核心工作：
blocks.en: Completing PQ (performance qualification) does not mean the end of the sterilization process. It moves into the "ongoing maintenance" phase. PDA TR1 groups this phase into four core activities:

blocks.zh: 週期參數審查：每次滅菌週期均需審查關鍵參數是否符合確效範圍
blocks.en: Cycle parameter review: the critical parameters of every sterilization cycle must be reviewed against the validated ranges

blocks.zh: 系統適用性確認：定期確認滅菌器硬體功能正常
blocks.en: System suitability: periodically confirm that the sterilizer hardware is functioning properly

blocks.zh: 變更管控：任何系統或產品變更均須書面化並評估影響
blocks.en: Change control: any system or product change must be documented and assessed for impact

blocks.zh: 再確效：定期（通常每12個月）重新確認製程有效性
blocks.en: Requalification: periodically (typically every 12 months) reconfirm that the process remains effective

blocks.zh: 比喻：汽車維保制度
blocks.en: Analogy: A Vehicle Maintenance Program

blocks.zh: 完成新車驗收（PQ）後，駕駛人仍需定期回廠保養（再確效）、每趟出門前確認車輛狀態（系統適用性），並在改裝後重新評估安全性（變更管控）。持續控制就是GMP版的「車輛保養計畫」。
blocks.en: After a new car passes acceptance (PQ), the driver still takes it in for regular servicing (requalification), checks its condition before every trip (system suitability), and reassesses its safety after any modification (change control). Ongoing control is the GMP version of a "vehicle maintenance plan."

blocks.zh: Routine Release | 常規放行
blocks.en: Routine Release

blocks.zh: 實務要點
blocks.en: Practical Points

blocks.zh: 無論採用哪種放行策略，週期記錄（Cycle Record）的參數審查都是必要的。參數放行並非「不做生物指示劑」，而是「以完整的製程數據作為主要放行依據」。
blocks.en: Whichever release strategy is used, review of the parameters in the cycle record is always required. Parametric release does not mean "no biological indicators"; it means "using complete process data as the primary basis for release."

blocks.zh: Sterilizer System Suitability | 滅菌器系統適用性
blocks.en: Sterilizer System Suitability

blocks.zh: 空氣偵測器的重要性
blocks.en: The Importance of Air Detectors

blocks.zh: 安裝在腔室排水處的空氣偵測器，若已通過適當確效，可同時取代腔室洩漏測試與空氣去除測試。這對於降低日常測試負擔具有實際意義，但前提是設備必須持續校驗且確效文件完整。
blocks.en: An air detector installed at the chamber drain, if properly validated, can replace both the chamber leak test and the air removal test. This is of practical value in reducing the routine testing burden, but only if the equipment is continuously calibrated and the validation documentation is complete.

blocks.zh: 比喻：飛機起飛前的例行檢查清單
blocks.en: Analogy: The Pre-Flight Checklist

blocks.zh: 系統適用性測試就像飛行員的起飛前檢查清單——不是每次都做全套引擎拆解，而是確認儀表、氣密、控制面板均在正常狀態。頻率和範圍由公司SOP和法規規定，但目的都是「確認設備準備好了」。
blocks.en: System suitability testing is like a pilot's pre-flight checklist. It does not mean stripping down the engines every time; it means confirming that the instruments, seals and control panel are all in normal condition. Frequency and scope are set by company SOPs and regulations, but the purpose is always to "confirm the equipment is ready."

blocks.zh: Change Control | 變更管控
blocks.en: Change Control

blocks.zh: 變更管控套件六大要素
blocks.en: The Six Elements of a Change Control Package

blocks.zh: 變更描述
blocks.en: Description of the change

blocks.zh: 變更原因/理由
blocks.en: Reason/justification for the change

blocks.zh: 所需確效測試說明（或小變更的技術理由）
blocks.en: Description of the validation tests required (or the technical rationale for a minor change)

blocks.zh: 測試執行記錄、結果解釋與結論
blocks.en: Test execution records, interpretation of results and conclusions

blocks.zh: 確認相關文件已同步更新
blocks.en: Confirmation that related documents have been updated accordingly

blocks.zh: 品質單位及管理層核准簽署
blocks.en: Approval signatures from the quality unit and management

blocks.zh: 這六項缺一不可，是稽查時的高頻查核點。
blocks.en: None of these six items can be omitted, and they are frequent checkpoints during inspections.

blocks.zh: 實務場景：如何判斷「主要變更」？
blocks.en: Practical Scenario: How Do You Decide Whether a Change Is "Major"?

blocks.zh: 問自己三個問題：(1) 這個變更會改變負載的熱分布嗎？(2) 蒸氣到達最冷點的路徑有沒有變？(3) 產品的生物負擔特性或質量有無改變？若任何一項為「是」，建議啟動再確效評估流程。
blocks.en: Ask yourself three questions: (1) Will the change alter the heat distribution of the load? (2) Has the path by which steam reaches the cold spot changed? (3) Have the bioburden characteristics or quality of the product changed? If the answer to any of them is "yes," it is advisable to start a requalification assessment.

blocks.zh: Periodic Requalification | 定期再確效
blocks.en: Periodic Requalification

blocks.zh: 等效滅菌器的再確效簡化
blocks.en: Simplified Requalification for Equivalent Sterilizers

blocks.zh: 若設施內多台滅菌器已建立等效性（Section 5.4），可減少再確效活動範圍——例如，不必對每台滅菌器重複確效每一種產品配方。但此簡化必須以書面等效性評估為前提，並在SOP中明確記載。
blocks.en: If equivalence has been established among multiple sterilizers in a facility (Section 5.4), the scope of requalification activities can be reduced. For example, it is not necessary to repeat validation of every product formulation on every sterilizer. However, this simplification must be based on a documented equivalence assessment and clearly stated in the SOP.

blocks.zh: 比喻：年度健康檢查
blocks.en: Analogy: The Annual Health Check

blocks.zh: 再確效如同個人年度健康檢查——不是因為懷疑有病才去，而是系統性地確認一切仍在基準範圍內。若發現異常趨勢（如校驗值偏移），則需進一步調查，就像健檢報告出現異常值需追蹤複查。
blocks.en: Requalification is like a personal annual health check. You do not go because you suspect illness; you go to systematically confirm that everything is still within the baseline range. If an adverse trend is found (such as calibration drift), further investigation is needed, just as an abnormal value in a health check report calls for follow-up testing.

blocks.zh: 練習思考題 | Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh:
Q1: 工廠將一台滅菌器的腔室排氣管路延長了30公分以配合廠房改建。這是否屬於需要再確效的主要變更？請說明判斷依據。
A facility extended a sterilizer chamber drain line by 30 cm to accommodate a plant renovation. Is this a major change requiring requalification? Explain your reasoning.
blocks.en:
Q1: A plant extended a sterilizer chamber drain line by 30 cm to accommodate a plant renovation. Is this a major change requiring requalification? Explain your reasoning.

blocks.zh:
Q2: 一批終端滅菌的LVP產品，其週期記錄顯示F0達標，但腔室內一個溫度探頭的「重要參數」（key parameter）記錄值低於確效範圍0.1°C。依照TR1規定，品管單位應如何處理？
A batch of terminally sterilized LVP shows F0 met the target, but one thermocouple recorded a key parameter 0.1°C below the qualified range. How should QA disposition this batch per TR1?
blocks.en:

blocks.zh: References | 參考文獻
blocks.en: References

blocks.zh: 參考文獻解說
blocks.en: Notes on the References

blocks.zh: 最重要的三份文獻
blocks.en: The Three Most Important References

blocks.zh: #24 FDA Aseptic Processing Guidance (2004) — 美國FDA無菌製程最核心的法規文件，TR1的許多要求與此呼應
blocks.en: #24 FDA Aseptic Processing Guidance (2004) — the core US FDA regulatory document on aseptic processing; many TR1 requirements echo it

blocks.zh: #16 Pflug (2007) — PDA指定的滅菌微生物學標準教科書，D值/F0計算的權威來源
blocks.en: #16 Pflug (2007) — the standard sterilization microbiology textbook designated by PDA, and the authoritative source for D-value/F0 calculations

blocks.zh: #12 ISO 11138-1:2006 — 生物指示劑的ISO標準，定義BI的規格要求與性能測試方法
blocks.en: #12 ISO 11138-1:2006 — the ISO standard for biological indicators, defining BI specification requirements and performance test methods

blocks.zh: 為什麼參考文獻很重要？
blocks.en: Why Do the References Matter?

blocks.zh: TR1的每一個技術要求都有其學術與法規依據。稽查員可能詢問「你們的F0計算依據是哪個標準？」——能指向Pflug教科書或ISO標準，就是科學合理性的展現。熟悉這份文獻清單，有助於在稽查中建立信心。
blocks.en: Every technical requirement in TR1 has an academic and regulatory basis. An inspector may ask, "What standard is your F0 calculation based on?" Being able to point to the Pflug textbook or the ISO standard demonstrates scientific justification. Knowing this reference list well helps build confidence during inspections.
